source_admission: Published values and equations the study uses, with how far each was read on 2026-10-17. No outside dataset or full paper is committed; the study's other inputs are the project's committed products and the GCM's own output. 'formula checked' means the equation was transcribed from the source and verified by the tests; 'abstract' means the values were read from the abstract or a summary of it; 'secondary' means the value was read in a later paper or summary that quotes it.

sources.citation: U.S. Geological Survey Office of Water Quality 2011, Change to solubility equations for oxygen in water, Technical Memorandum 2011.03 (with S.A. Rounds's attachment)
sources.use: biosphere/ecology/lake.py oxygen_saturation: Garcia and Gordon's baseline (equations 12-14), Benson and Krause's pressure factor with the vapour pressure and the virial term (equations 9-11), the 1.42905 mg/mL conversion and the stated validity of 0-40 C, 0-40 g/kg and 0.5-1.1 atm; Weiss's salinity factor (equation 3) as an independent check
